capabilities: Define variables in frontmatter and update all references instantly
Insert local and vault-wide variable references via commands
Run queries and custom JavaScript in code blocks
Save reusable custom functions and call them by name
Edit variable references in place and highlight dynamic content
disambiguation: Not a template inserter; variables live in note properties and references update dynamically rather than being pasted from a template.
extras: The README includes a sponsor link and frames the plugin as donation-funded; feature demos are shown as videos/images that were stripped from the text.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to define a value once in a note's properties and have references to it update automatically everywhere in the vault.
summary: Variable plugin that defines reusable variables in note properties and keeps every reference across the vault updated, with query code blocks and custom JavaScript functions.
